plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan focuses on capital preservation by eliminating leveraged positions and reducing concentration. Expect lower potential returns but also significantly reduced downside risk and volatility.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to small positions.

balanced.read: This balanced approach trims leverage and concentration while adding a quality name. It seeks to capture some upside while managing risk, aiming for moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU).

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, CRWD, SNOW).

income.read: This income-focused plan shifts entirely to yield-generating assets and broad index exposure, cutting all speculative and leveraged positions. Expect low volatility and consistent distributions, but minimal capital appreciation.
